details.scope: Pinned input receipts; no new remote environment or weight-tensor inspection.

details.limits: Extraction checked against compact norm/binding receipts; retired source tensors not re-decoded.
Compact presentations/work/boundary receipts; model and Adam tensors are not re-decoded.
No remote tensor/existence audit; no deleted tensors reconstructed.

material_passport.scope: Independent code reconstruction of compact evidence; same-team author overlap, not an independent GPU reproduction.

fallacy_coverage: 11/11 categories; empirical conclusions conditional on complete valid evidence

fallacies.name: Simpson's paradox
fallacies.assessment: Pooled/domain ratios and gross harms remain visible; inspect direction disagreements.

fallacies.name: Ecological fallacy
fallacies.assessment: Pooled ratio describes this panel, not every request; wins/regressions/ties remain explicit.

fallacies.name: Berkson's paradox
fallacies.assessment: Fixed reused development inventories are selected populations, not deployment traffic.

fallacies.name: Collider bias
fallacies.assessment: Selection reads past prompt descriptors, never labels/loss/outcomes; invalid records cannot be silently excluded.

fallacies.name: Base rate neglect
fallacies.assessment: Final strata128/128 and future math256/coding512 are design choices, not population prevalence.

fallacies.name: Regression to the mean
fallacies.assessment: Contemporaneous K/U controls and no outcome-selected samples limit regression-to-mean explanations.

fallacies.name: Survivorship bias
fallacies.assessment: Complete schedules and attempted/unknown work are checked; incomplete campaigns get no efficacy verdict.

fallacies.name: Look-elsewhere effect
fallacies.assessment: R/U is primary and R/K required; domain, U/K and time intervals remain descriptive/unadjusted.

fallacies.name: Garden of forking paths
fallacies.assessment: Seed/descriptor/dose/memory/schedule/bootstrap fixed; reused panel is not confirmatory.

fallacies.name: Correlation versus causation
fallacies.assessment: Shared K supervision and one trajectory do not establish universal causality or deployment/net speedup.

fallacies.name: Reverse causality
fallacies.assessment: Replay records are strictly past; future serving first changes at event3 after the event2 update.

private_data_policy: No private prompt or response tokens emitted.
